purpose: First2x2 ablation of public context and learned action priors; supervised search distillation, not yet iterative online RL
collection: 1200 baseline3ply/24000 normal games; independent reservoir samples in four max-rank bands, plus final pre-death state for failed games; include successful games
teacher: Fully completed4ply expectimax with frozen baseline leaves; all chance outcomes enumerated
policyLabels: Softmax of full4ply action values at temperature2000; soft distribution, not MCTS visit counts
split: Source games with (seed-11010001)%5==0 validation; others training; augmentation never crosses game split
architecture: Shared32-ReLU residual MLP per projected action; sparse16x16 rank one-hot; base afterstate value; optional preview probability vector,3 public remaining counts,16-entry mask. Score residual and policy-logit residual heads. Zero initial heads preserve baseline.
training: 30epochs; Adamlr.001; batch16states; Huber normalized score residual(scale8000) plus joint-only .2 policyKL; D4 augmentation transforms board and entry mask. Keep score weights and1536+ value boundary frozen.
checkpoint: Lowest common validation Huber+.2policyKL; policy-only groups evaluated with their trained prior, value-only with softmax correctedQ; validation never used for game success claims
evaluation: Every arm and all3 seeds, plus unchanged MCTS baseline,512 common fresh games each;1msCPU per move; stop1536/death. Search randomness separated from game RNG.
statistics: Report per-training-seed rates. Factorial contrasts average3 replicas within each game seed; paired uncertainty clusters by game seed. Three training seeds do not quantify full training variance precisely. Co-primary contrasts: context main effect and policy main effect, Holm correction over two tests. All candidate-versus-baseline results exploratory; game-level CIs conditional on these three training seeds.
promotion: Research diagnostics first; no default promotion without independent later-stage/browser validation; no picking another checkpoint from game results
